description: Java class implementing helper methods for creating and validating JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with user claims, including token creation, expansion, and configuration-based signing key management.

classes.name: AuthTokenHelperImpl
classes.description: Helper class for creating and validating JWTs with user claims, extending JwtHelper and implementing AuthTokenHelper.

methods.name: forSigning
methods.description: Creates a helper for signing JWTs using provided Vertx instance and configuration.

methods.name: forValidating
methods.description: Creates a helper for validating JWTs using provided Vertx instance and configuration.

methods.name: forSharedSecret
methods.description: Creates a helper for creating/validating HmacSHA256 JWT assertions with a shared secret.

methods.name: createToken
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT token with specified authorization ID and authorities.

methods.name: expand
methods.description: Parses and validates a JWT token, returning its claims.
